# Dr Oscar Mendez

> Dr Oscar Mendez (Oscar Mendez Maldonado) is a physical AI leader based in Surrey, UK. He is Director of AI & Data Science at Locus Robotics, where he leads AI for an autonomous mobile robot fleet operating at more than 350 sites worldwide, and a Visiting Associate Professor in Robotics and AI at the University of Surrey's Centre for Vision, Speech and Signal Processing (CVSSP).

Key facts:

- Current roles: Director of AI & Data Science, Locus Robotics (2025 to present; previously Machine Vision Lead, 2023 to 2025). Visiting Associate Professor in Robotics and AI, University of Surrey (2021 to present).
- Focus: physical and embodied AI; taking perception and decision-making models from research to robots in production; AI strategy for customers, investors and boards.
- Awards: ICRA 2022 Best Paper Award ("Translating Images into Maps"); Sullivan Doctoral Thesis Prize 2018 for the best UK computer vision PhD thesis.
- Record: 38 papers at venues including CVPR, ICCV, ICRA and IROS; four granted US patents (sensor calibration, water/non-water segmentation, bird's-eye-view semantic mapping) and one pending (warehouse labour orchestration).
- Research areas: bird's-eye-view mapping, localisation and geo-localisation, SLAM, 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, hyperspectral sensing, human pose estimation, graph learning.
- Education: PhD in Robotics, Computer Vision and AI (University of Surrey, CVSSP); BEng (Hons) Electronic and Computer Engineering, First Class (University of Surrey).
- Service and memberships: Sponsorship Chair, Executive Committee of the British Machine Vision Association; Fellow of the Higher Education Academy (FHEA); IEEE Member; Associate of the IET.
